description: Hardening, polish, and security audit. Ensures every security and quality requirement is met: no process.env outside env.ts, no secrets in client bundles, responsive layout at 360px, all loading/error states present, all emissions figures show units+sources+assumptions, vitest and build both clean. Depends on all prior FEATs.
steps: Search the entire src/ directory for any direct process.env access (grep pattern 'process\.env\.') in files other than src/lib/env.ts. Fix any occurrences by importing from src/lib/env.ts instead.

Search src/app/ for any import of src/lib/env.ts from a file that is a client component ('use client' directive at top). env.ts must only be imported from server components, route handlers, and server-side lib files. Fix any violations by moving the env read to a server action or route handler and passing the non-secret value as a prop.
Verify RECORDER_PRIVATE_KEY and DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY are never referenced outside src/lib/env.ts, src/lib/chain/anchor.ts, and src/lib/chain/read.ts. These must never appear in any client bundle.

Search for console.log, console.error, console.warn calls across src/ that could expose secret values (API keys, private keys, full error stacks). Replace with safe logging that logs error codes/types only.

Walk through every UI page at 360px width: src/app/page.tsx (dashboard), src/app/batches/new/page.tsx, src/app/batches/[id]/page.tsx, src/app/batches/[id]/review/page.tsx, src/app/passport/[batchCode]/page.tsx, src/app/verify/page.tsx. Fix any Tailwind classes that would cause horizontal overflow at 360px (e.g. use overflow-x-auto on tables, use responsive text sizes, ensure form inputs have w-full).

Verify every async page has all four states — loading (skeleton or spinner), empty (helpful message), error (user-friendly error with retry where applicable), success (content) — per NFR-11. Check: dashboard (empty batch list state), batch detail (no evidence yet state), report view (no run yet state), passport (batch not found state).

Verify CarbonPanel shows units on every emissions figure, shows factor_source for each line, shows the boundary statement, and shows the ILLUSTRATIVE_FACTORS warning banner when applicable — per NFR-12. If any of these are missing, add them.
Run npx vitest run — confirm all 5 test files pass with 0 failures. Fix any regressions.
Run npm run build — confirm 0 TypeScript errors and 0 build errors. Fix any issues.
Verify the Foundry tests still pass and have not been accidentally modified: run forge test from the repo root and confirm 20 tests pass. Do NOT modify any files in contracts/, test/, or script/.
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run passes all tests (cross-checker, climate-analyst, canonical, status-policy, auditor-postprocess) with 0 failures
npm run build exits 0 with no TypeScript errors
forge test passes 20/20 tests (pre-existing Foundry tests unchanged)
No direct process.env access in any file outside src/lib/env.ts
No import of env.ts from client components ('use client' files)
RECORDER_PRIVATE_KEY never appears in any client-side bundle or client component
All pages render correctly at 360px width without horizontal overflow
CarbonPanel displays units, factor source, and assumptions for every emissions line
DemoBanner appears on all demo batch pages (is_demo=true)
